% Pattern: head/macro/article and env/titled/article. A paper command that
% writes its argument in bold, an environment whose first argument is the
% title, a counter reset at each section, and a paper command for the end of a
% proof.
% from 1003.5948
% want head-1 statement/theorem - status=none
% want thm-1 statement/claim 1.1 status=here labels=clm:a
% want head-2 proof - proves=thm-1
% want thm-2 statement/proposition 2.1 status=here
% want head-3 proof - proves=thm-2
\documentclass{article}
\makeatletter
\def\parit#1{\smallskip\noindent{\it #1}}
\def\parbf#1{\smallskip\noindent{\bf #1}}
\def\qeds{\qed\par\medskip}
\newcounter{thm}[section]
\renewcommand{\thethm}{\thesection.\arabic{thm}}
\def\claim#1{\par\medskip\noindent\refstepcounter{thm}\hbox{\bf \arabic{section}.\arabic{thm}. #1.}\it\ }
\def\endclaim{\par\medskip}
\newenvironment{thm}{\claim}{\endclaim}
\makeatother
\begin{document}
\parbf{Main theorem.}
Every space of this kind has the property.

\section{First}
\begin{thm}{Claim}\label{clm:a}
A claim.
\end{thm}

\parit{Proof.}
A proof. \qeds

\section{Second}
\begin{thm}{Proposition}
A proposition.
\end{thm}

\begin{figure}
A figure between the statement and its proof.
\end{figure}

\parit{Proof.}
Another proof. \qeds
\end{document}
